description: Artificial Forecasting Project Outputs is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. Our Artificial Forecasting Project Outputs dataset contains findings from the beta-phase of the Artificial Forecasting SIF (strategic innovation fund) project. The data is from two sets of substations Primary (EHV-HV transformation); Gross demand (kW), customer export (kW) and net demand (kW). Five years of historical data. Contains 486 sites. Secondary (HV-LV transformation); Net demand (W). Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Network. Its keywords are Extra High Voltage (EHV), High Voltage (HV), Low Voltage (LV), Forecast, Innovation. The portal shows 2024-04-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
